models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.quant: Vulkan, UD-Q4_K_XL target + Q8_0 DFlash2 drafter (n=4), speculative decode; decode at 32K context (26.39 t/s at 0K, 21.58 at 8K); stock decoding on the same box: 11.81 / 11.44 / 10.54 t/s at 0K/8K/32K
engines.engine_min_version: llama.cpp PR #27342 (DFlash 2 speculative decoding, not in mainline yet)

models.why: On a 128GB Strix Halo, llama.cpp Vulkan with a DFlash2 drafter doubles Qwen3.8-27B decode at 32K context (10.54 to 21.11 tok/s); the same post's strix-llama.cpp figure (312 t/s) is prefill.
